title: Molecular screening of arboviruses in asymptomatic blood donors from Northern Brazil
abstract: BACKGROUND: Asymptomatic infections caused by the arboviruses dengue virus (DENV), zika virus (ZIKV) and chikungunya virus (CHIKV) pose a hidden risk to blood safety, as viremic donors may contribute to transfusion-transmitted infections with severe outcomes. METHODS: Viral RNA from 5,954 pools (each pool contains six samples) was extracted using the ChemagicTM PrimeTM platform, as part of the Brazilian NAT PLUS system from pooled plasma samples collected at Amazonas Hematology and Hemotherapy Hospital Foundation (HEMOAM) and analyzed by RT-qPCR using the ZC D-Tipagem molecular assay (Bio-Manguinhos). RESULTS: Over eighteen consecutive epidemiological weeks, 11 CHIKV-positive cases were identified, 4 DENV-positive cases, and no ZIKV-positive detections on the blood bags samples analyzed. CONCLUSION: The detection of asymptomatic arboviral infections during the rainy season, when environmental conditions favor mosquito proliferation and arbovirus transmission, suggests ongoing silent viral circulation in the region and reinforces the importance of blood donor surveillance.
authors: Luiz Paulo de Brito Oliveira Souza

METHODS: Viral RNA from 5,954 pools (each pool contains six samples) was extracted using the ChemagicTM PrimeTM platform, as part of the Brazilian NAT PLUS system from pooled plasma samples collected at Amazonas Hematology and Hemotherapy Hospital Foundation (HEMOAM) and analyzed by RT-qPCR using the ZC D-Tipagem molecular assay (Bio-Manguinhos). RESULTS: Over eighteen consecutive epidemiological weeks, 11 CHIKV-positive cases were identified, 4 DENV-positive cases, and no ZIKV-positive detections on the blood bags samples analyzed. CONCLUSION: The detection of asymptomatic arboviral infections during the rainy season, when environmental conditions favor mosquito proliferation and arbovirus transmission, suggests ongoing silent viral circulation in the region and reinforces the importance of blood donor surveillance.
abstract_zh: 背景:由虫媒病毒登革病毒(登革病毒DENV)、寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)引起的无症状感染对血液安全构成潜在风险,因为病毒血症献血者可能传播严重的输血相关感染。方法:使用ChemagicTM PrimeTM平台从5,954个样本池(每个样本池包含六个样本)中提取病毒RNA,作为巴西NAT PLUS系统的一部分,分析来自亚马逊州血液学与输血病学医院基金会(HEMOAM)收集的混合血浆样本,采用RT-qPCR方法使用ZC D-Tipagem分子检测(Bio-Manguinhos)。结果:在连续十八个流行病学周内,共检测到11例CHIKV阳性病例、4例DENV阳性病例,以及在分析的血袋样本中未检测到ZIKV阳性病例。结论:在雨季期间检测到由虫媒病毒传播引起的无症状感染,表明该地区存在持续的隐性病毒传播,并强调了对献血者监测进行监测的重要性。

title: Short-Term Forecasting of Weekly Dengue Cases in Singapore Using ARIMA and Fourier-ARIMA Models
abstract: Dengue remains a recurring public health issue in Singapore, where sudden weekly increases in reported cases can create pressure on surveillance, healthcare response, and vector-control planning. This study builds a short-term forecasting framework using official weekly dengue surveillance data from 2012-W01 to 2026-W17. The dataset was reorganized into a continuous epidemiological-week time series, and total dengue cases were defined by combining dengue fever and dengue hemorrhagic fever cases. Because the raw series contains outbreak spikes and unstable variance, the log transformation was used before model fitting. The analysis then applied ACF/PACF inspection, differencing, ARIMA search, Fourier-ARIMA comparison, residual diagnostics, and chronological train-test validation. The first 673 weeks were used for training, and the final 75 weeks were used for one-week-ahead testing. Results indicate that ARIMA(4,1,0)+Fourier(2) offers the strongest balance between prediction accuracy, residual adequacy, and model simplicity. The model should be understood as a practical surveillance baseline rather than a complete explanation of dengue transmission.
journal: International Journal of Biology and Life Sciences

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the need for improved dengue surveillance in Singapore, where sudden weekly increases in cases pose challenges for public health response. The research focuses on developing a short-term forecasting framework using weekly dengue surveillance data from 2012-W01 to 2026-W17. The dataset was reorganized into a continuous time series, with total cases defined by combining dengue fever and dengue hemorrhagic fever. The analysis applied ACF/PACF inspection, differencing, ARIMA search, Fourier-ARIMA comparison, residual diagnostics, and chronological train-test validation. The model used the first 673 weeks for training and the final 75 weeks for one-week-ahead testing. Results show that ARIMA(4,1,0)+Fourier(2) provides the best balance of prediction accuracy, residual adequacy, and model simplicity. title_zh: 使用ARIMA和傅里叶-ARIMA模型对新加坡每周登革热病例进行短期预测
source_body_en: Dengue remains a recurring public health issue in Singapore, where sudden weekly increases in reported cases can create pressure on surveillance, healthcare response, and vector-control planning. This study builds a short-term forecasting framework using official weekly dengue surveillance data from 2012-W01 to 2026-W17. The dataset was reorganized into a continuous epidemiological-week time series, and total dengue cases were defined by combining dengue fever and dengue hemorrhagic fever cases. Because the raw series contains outbreak spikes and unstable variance, the log transformation was used before model fitting. The analysis then applied ACF/PACF inspection, differencing, ARIMA search, Fourier-ARIMA comparison, residual diagnostics, and chronological train-test validation. The first 673 weeks were used for training, and the final 75 weeks were used for one-week-ahead testing. Results indicate that ARIMA(4,1,0)+Fourier(2) offers the strongest balance between prediction accuracy, residual adequacy, and model simplicity. The model should be understood as a practical surveillance baseline rather than a complete explanation of dengue transmission.
abstract_zh: 登革热仍然是新加坡反复出现的公共卫生问题,其中每周报告病例的突然增加会对监测、医疗响应和媒介控制规划造成压力。本研究利用2012-W01至2026-W17期间官方发布的每周登革热监测数据,构建了一个短期预测框架。该数据集被重新组织为连续的流行病学周时间序列,总登革热病例通过合并登革热和登革热出血病例来定义。由于原始序列包含暴发尖峰和不稳定的方差,在模型拟合前采用了对数变换。分析过程中应用了ACF/PACF检验、差分、ARIMA搜索、傅里叶-ARIMA比较、残差诊断以及时间序列的训练-测试验证。前673周用于训练,最后75周用于一周期的测试。结果表明,ARIMA(4,1,0)+Fourier(2)在预测准确性、残差充分性和模型简洁性之间提供了最佳平衡。该模型应被理解为一种实用的监测基准,而非对登革热传播的完整解释。

title: Direct Interaction of Dengue Virus with Human Platelets Drives Membrane Remodeling, Caspase-3 Activation, and Extracellular Vesicle Release
abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) infection is a frequent cause of acute thrombocytopenia and platelet dysfunction, yet underlying cellular mechanisms remain incompletely understood. In this study, we investigated the dynamics of platelet activation, morphological changes, apoptosis, and extracellular vesicle (EV) release in human platelets exposed to DENV-2 (MOI 0.1) for 2 h and 4 h. Washed platelets from healthy donors (n=5) exhibited marked donor-to-donor heterogeneity in CD62P and CD40L surface mobilization, with no statistically significant shifts in positivity or mean fluorescence intensity (p>0.05). Conversely, scanning electron microscopy morphometry demonstrated significant platelet spreading, showing increased equatorial diameter at 2 h and 4 h versus mock controls (p 0.05), but DENV-2 preferentially enriched medium-sized microvesicles (150–250 nm). These findings suggest that platelet responses to DENV-2 exhibit a distinct pattern of degranulation, morphological spreading, and for caspase-3-mediated apoptotic activation, providing new insights into cellular mechanisms potentially contributing of the dengue-induced thrombocytopenia.

title: A Comparative Analysis of the Immunotranscriptomic Features of DENV-1, -3, and -4 Human Challenge Models.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue virus (DENV) infections cause a range of clinical symptoms, from a mild febrile illness to severe disease. Higher levels of DENV RNAemia are associated with severe dengue, although this relationship is incompletely understood. Dengue human infection models (DHIMs), in which volunteers are experimentally infected with underattenuated DENV strains, provide an invaluable tool for studying early virologic, transcriptional, and immunologic features of infection. DHIM studies using DENV-1, DENV-3, and DENV-4 have demonstrated qualitatively distinct clinical features; however, the contribution of RNAemia and serotype to divergent transcriptional and clinical profiles in these challenge models remains unclear. METHODS: In this work, we performed a comparative analysis of DHIM-1, DHIM-3, and DHIM-4 studies to determine shared and unique features of the transcriptional response to infection and their associations with RNAemia and clinical symptoms. We then exposed primary human peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) in vitro to DENV-1 or DENV-3 at varying titers and performed bulk RNA sequencing. RESULTS: Across DHIMs, we identified a set of conserved, upregulated genes at day of peak RNAemia, representing a core antiviral response independent of serotype. Further, a unique gene signature indicating downregulated cytoplasmic translation emerged in a subset of DHIM-3 participants with elevated RNAemia and symptomatology. In vitro PBMC exposure to DENV demonstrated that conserved and unique gene expression signatures varied as a function of viral dose rather than serotype. CONCLUSIONS: These data show that viral burden correlates with transcriptional responses and clinical symptomatology following experimental DENV infection, contributing to our understanding of dengue pathogenesis and immunity.

analysis.summary_en: This study compares the immunotranscriptomic features of DENV-1, DENV-3, and DENV-4 human challenge models to understand the relationship between viral burden, transcriptional responses, and clinical symptoms. The research identifies conserved antiviral gene responses across serotypes and a unique gene signature in DENV-3 challenge models associated with elevated RNAemia and symptomatology. In vitro experiments show that gene expression signatures vary with viral dose rather than serotype. These findings contribute to understanding dengue pathogenesis and immunity, with implications for vaccine and therapeutic development. The study is based on abstract-only evidence, which limits the depth of analysis and suggests moderate confidence in the results.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革病毒(DENV)感染可引起一系列临床症状,从轻度发热性疾病到严重疾病。较高的DENV RNAemia水平与严重疾病相关,尽管这种关系尚未完全理解。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用DENV-1、DENV-3和DENV-4进行的DHIM研究已显示出不同的临床特征;然而,RNAemia和血清型对这些挑战模型中不同的转录组学和临床特征的贡献仍不清楚。
elements_zh.methods: 在本研究中,我们对DHIM-1、DHIM-3和DHIM-4进行了比较分析,以确定感染的转录组学反应的共同和独特特征及其与RNAemia和临床症状的关联。随后,我们将人外周血单核细胞(PBMCs)在体外暴露于不同滴度的DENV-1或DENV-3,并进行了批量RNA测序。
elements_zh.main_results: 在所有DHIM中,我们发现了一组在RNAemia峰值日上调的保守基因,代表了一种与血清型无关的核心免疫应答反应。此外,在一组具有较高RNAemia水平和症状的DHIM-3参与者中,出现了指示细胞质翻译下调的独特基因特征。体外PBMC暴露于DENV显示,保守和独特的基因表达特征随病毒剂量变化而变化,而非血清型。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些数据表明,病毒载量与实验性DENV感染后的转录组学反应和临床症状相关,有助于我们理解登革热的发病机制和免疫性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为理解登革热的发病机制和免疫性提供了见解,可能有助于开发更有效的诊断工具、治疗策略和疫苗。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅基于摘要证据,可能无法全面反映研究结果。由于缺乏详细的实验数据,证据强度中等。

title_zh: 登革病毒1型、3型和4型人体挑战模型的免疫转录组学特征比较分析
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Dengue virus (DENV) infections cause a range of clinical symptoms, from a mild febrile illness to severe disease. Higher levels of DENV RNAemia are associated with severe dengue, although this relationship is incompletely understood. Dengue human infection models (DHIMs), in which volunteers are experimentally infected with underattenuated DENV strains, provide an invaluable tool for studying early virologic, transcriptional, and immunologic features of infection. DHIM studies using DENV-1, DENV-3, and DENV-4 have demonstrated qualitatively distinct clinical features; however, the contribution of RNAemia and serotype to divergent transcriptional and clinical profiles in these challenge models remains unclear. METHODS: In this work, we performed a comparative analysis of DHIM-1, DHIM-3, and DHIM-4 studies to determine shared and unique features of the transcriptional response to infection and their associations with RNAemia and clinical symptoms. We then exposed primary human peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) in vitro to DENV-1 or DENV-3 at varying titers and performed bulk RNA sequencing. RESULTS: Across DHIMs, we identified a set of conserved, upregulated genes at day of peak RNAemia, representing a core antiviral response independent of serotype. Further, a unique gene signature indicating downregulated cytoplasmic translation emerged in a subset of DHIM-3 participants with elevated RNAemia and symptomatology. In vitro PBMC exposure to DENV demonstrated that conserved and unique gene expression signatures varied as a function of viral dose rather than serotype. CONCLUSIONS: These data show that viral burden correlates with transcriptional responses and clinical symptomatology following experimental DENV infection, contributing to our understanding of dengue pathogenesis and immunity.
abstract_zh: 背景:登革病毒(DENV)感染可引起一系列临床症状,从轻度发热性疾病到严重疾病。较高的DENV RNAemia水平与严重疾病相关,尽管这种关系尚未完全理解。在人体感染模型(DHIMs)中,志愿者被实验性感染低减毒的DENV株,为研究感染的早期病毒学、转录组学和免疫学特征提供了宝贵的工具。使用DENV-1、DENV-3和DENV-4进行的DHIM研究已显示出不同的临床特征;然而,RNAemia和血清型对这些挑战模型中不同的转录组学和临床特征的贡献仍不清楚。方法:在本研究中,我们对DHIM-1、DHIM-3和DHIM-4进行了比较分析,以确定感染的转录组学反应的共同和独特特征及其与RNAemia和临床症状的关联。随后,我们将人外周血单核细胞(PBMCs)在体外暴露于不同滴度的DENV-1或DENV-3,并进行了批量RNA测序。结果:在所有DHIM中,我们发现了一组在RNAemia峰值日上调的保守基因,代表了一种与血清型无关的核心免疫应答反应。此外,在一组具有较高RNAemia水平和症状的DHIM-3参与者中,出现了指示细胞质翻译下调的独特基因特征。体外PBMC暴露于DENV显示,保守和独特的基因表达特征随病毒剂量变化而变化,而非血清型。结论:这些数据表明,病毒载量与实验性DENV感染后的转录组学反应和临床症状相关,有助于我们理解登革热的发病机制和免疫性。科学与公共卫生意义:这些发现为理解登革热的发病机制和免疫性提供了见解,可能有助于开发更有效的诊断工具、治疗策略和疫苗。局限性与证据强度:本研究仅基于摘要证据,可能无法全面反映研究结果。由于缺乏详细的实验数据,证据强度中等。

title: A Mathematical Model of Dengue and Lassa Fever Co-Infection with Education and Vector Control
abstract: Dengue and Lassa fever co-circulate in Nigeria, yet few models examine their co-infection alongside behavioural and clinical interventions. This study develops a deterministic compartmental model of dengue–Lassa fever co-infection that couples human, mosquito and rodent dynamics and distinguishes educated from uneducated susceptible individuals. We derive the basic and effective reproduction numbers using the next-generation operator approach, and establish local and global stability of the disease-free equilibrium via a Lyapunov function, together with global stability of the endemic equilibria using a Goh–Volterra function. Sensitivity analysis identifies the parameters that most strongly influence transmission, and the model is calibrated against Nigerian surveillance data. Numerical simulations confirm the analytical results and show that public education, reduced human–vector contact and treatment of co-infected cases lower infection levels.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a mathematical model of dengue and Lassa fever co-infection in Nigeria, incorporating human, mosquito, and rodent dynamics. The model distinguishes between educated and uneducated susceptible individuals and uses a next-generation operator approach to derive reproduction numbers. It also employs a Lyapunov function and a Goh–Volterra function to assess the stability of disease-free and endemic equilibria. Sensitivity analysis highlights key parameters influencing transmission, and the model is calibrated against Nigerian surveillance data. Numerical simulations demonstrate that public education, reduced human–vector contact, and treatment of co-infected cases can lower infection levels. The study contributes to understanding the dynamics of dengue co-infection and provides insights for public health interventions. However, the evidence does not report limitations or evidence strength, which may affect the confidence in the findings.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the need for preparedness in Latin America as a very strong El Niño is arriving over a population with little DENV-3 immunity.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is set in Latin America during the 2026-2027 El Niño event, focusing on a population with limited immunity to DENV-3.
analysis.methods: The study uses observational analysis to assess the potential impact of the El Niño event on DENV-3 transmission and immunity levels in the region.
analysis.main_results: The study reports that the El Niño event is expected to increase the risk of DENV-3 outbreaks in Latin America due to the population's low immunity.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the timing of the El Niño event provides a critical window for implementing preventive measures against DENV-3, highlighting the novelty of linking climate patterns to dengue preparedness.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform public health strategies for surveillance, vector control, and clinical preparedness in regions vulnerable to DENV-3 outbreaks during El Niño events.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on observational data and does not include direct empirical measurements, leading to a moderate confidence assessment in its conclusions.

analysis.summary_en: This study highlights the potential for a strong El Niño event in 2026-2027 to increase DENV-3 transmission risk in Latin America, where population immunity is low. The authors emphasize the importance of using the lead time before the event to implement preventive measures, including strengthening vector control, differentiating outbreaks, and preparing clinical capacity. The study is observational and does not include direct empirical measurements, which limits the confidence in its conclusions. The findings suggest that public health strategies should focus on surveillance and preparedness for DENV-3 outbreaks in the context of climate patterns. The study contributes to understanding the interplay between climate events and dengue transmission dynamics, offering insights for future research and intervention planning.

title: Dengue Surveillance Records from Caldas, Colombia, 2015–2024: Demographic, Clinical, and Care-Timing Data
abstract: This Data Descriptor presents 8294 dengue-related administrative surveillance records from Caldas, Colombia, reported during 2015–2024. The records originate from SIVIGILA open microdata made available by the Instituto Nacional de Salud (INS). The archived source contains 46 demographic, population-group, clinical, care-related, and administrative/geographic fields; its three event-date fields are stored at a year–month resolution, and two source-reported care-timing intervals are expressed in days. Event labels identify 8244 records as dengue cases and 50 as severe dengue cases; 3275 records indicate hospitalization. The repository preserves the original Spanish extract and provides an US-English representation, together with the accompanying R workflow and documentation. One spreadsheet-error token in the diarrhea field is treated as missing only in curated analytical outputs. Sixty-six exact-row groups involve 133 records, all retained because exact equality does not establish either duplicate episodes or unique individuals. Four clinical fields each contain 1148 missing values, concentrated in dengue-labeled records from 2017–2021; missing values in these fields are not interpreted as absence of the corresponding clinical condition. The accompanying R script reproduces the documented cleaning rules, descriptive tables, and figures without fitting predictive, inferential, classification, or survival models. The dataset supports transparent examination of record structure, completeness, terminology, and future analytical design, while not establishing population incidence, laboratory confirmation for every record, or the number of unique individuals.

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了哥伦比亚卡利达斯地区2015年至2024年间收集的8294条与登革热相关的行政监测记录。这些记录来源于国家卫生研究所(INS)提供的SIVIGILA开放微数据。
analysis_zh.methods: 该数据集包含46个人口统计学、临床和行政/地理字段,事件日期字段以年–月分辨率存储,两个护理时间间隔以天为单位表达。配套的R脚本在不拟合预测或推断模型的情况下,重现了记录的清理规则、描述性表格和图表。
analysis_zh.main_results: 事件标签识别出8244条记录为登革热病例,50条记录为重症登革热病例。此外,3275条记录表明住院。腹泻字段中的一个电子表格错误标记在经过整理的分析输出中被视为缺失;四个临床字段各包含1148个缺失值,主要集中在2017–2021年标记为登革热的记录中。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该数据集提供了对记录结构、完整性和术语的透明视角,为未来分析设计提供了见解,但并未建立人口发病率或每条记录的实验室确认。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为未来关于登革热监测、数据分析以及更准确的诊断和监测系统的开发提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该数据集未建立人口发病率、每条记录的实验室确认或唯一个体数量,且证据仅限于描述性分析,未进行推断建模。

title: Adhesion G protein-coupled receptor A2 promotes tick-borne encephalitis virus replication by interacting with NS2B to enhance viral protease activity.
abstract: Tick-borne encephalitis virus (TBEV) is a neurotropic flavivirus that causes severe neurological disease in humans, but the host factors required for its efficient replication remain incompletely understood. Here, we identify ADGRA2 as a novel host dependency factor for TBEV. Loss of ADGRA2, but not other ADGR family members, markedly restricts infection by multiple TBEV strains in human cells and primary mouse astrocytes. ADGRA2 is dispensable for viral entry but is required for efficient viral RNA replication, as demonstrated by impaired negative-strand RNA synthesis and accumulation of double-stranded RNA intermediates in ADGRA2-deficient cells. During infection, ADGRA2 is relocalized from the plasma membrane to the endoplasmic reticulum, where it functions independently of canonical WNT/β-catenin signaling. Mechanistically, ADGRA2 interacts with the viral cofactor NS2B, enhances NS2B-NS3 autocleavage and protease activity, promotes viral polyprotein processing, and facilitates NS2B/NS3 association with NS2A to enhance replication organelle biogenesis. ADGRA2 also promotes replication of Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV), Zika virus (ZIKV) and Dengue virus serotype 2 (DENV-2), suggesting a conserved role across flaviviruses. Together, these findings reveal that a host membrane receptor can be repurposed to drive NS2B-dependent protease maturation and replication complex assembly, thereby enabling efficient flaviviral replication.

abstract_zh: 蜱传脑炎病毒(TBEV)是一种神经嗜性黄病毒,可引起人类严重的神经系统疾病,但其高效的复制所需宿主因子仍不完全清楚。在这里,我们鉴定出ADGRA2为TBEV的一种新型宿主依赖因子。在人类细胞和原代小鼠星形胶质细胞中,ADGRA2的缺失,而非其他ADGR家族成员,显著限制了多种TBEV株的感染。ADGRA2对于病毒进入不必要,但对高效的病毒RNA复制是必需的,这在ADGRA2缺陷细胞中表现为负链RNA合成受损和双链RNA中间体的积累。在感染过程中,ADGRA2从质膜重新定位到内质网,在那里其功能独立于经典的WNT/β-连环蛋白信号通路。机制上,ADGRA2与病毒辅因子NS2B相互作用,增强NS2B-NS3自切割和蛋白酶活性,促进病毒多聚蛋白的加工,并促进NS2B/NS3与NS2A的结合,从而增强复制细胞器的生物合成。ADGRA2还促进日本脑炎病毒(JEV)、寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和登革病毒型2(DENV-2)的复制,表明其在黄病毒中的保守作用。综上所述,这些发现揭示了一种宿主膜受体可以被重新利用以驱动NS2B依赖的蛋白酶成熟和复制复合体组装,从而实现高效的黄病毒复制。

title: Galectin-3 restricts dengue virus infection through glycan-dependent envelope binding and enhances NF-κB signaling
abstract: Abstract Background No antiviral therapy is approved for dengue virus (DENV). Galectin-3 (Gal3), a β-galactoside-binding lectin, modulates several viral infections, but its role in DENV pathogenesis is unknown. Material and Methods Using a GFP-tagged DENV-2 reporter virus, we evaluated the effects of recombinant Gal3, Gal3 knockdown and Gal3 overexpression. Viral attachment, internalization, NF-κB signaling and cytokine expression were analyzed, together with molecular docking of Gal3 to the DENV envelope (E) protein. Disease outcomes were assessed in intracerebrally inoculated neonatal Gal3-knockout (Gal3-KO) mice. Results DENV-2 infection down-regulated endogenous Gal3. Extracellularly, recombinant Gal3 reduced DENV-2 infectivity and progeny production in a dose-dependent manner, and conditioned medium containing cell-secreted Gal3 had a similar effect. The inhibition was reversed by lactose, and by the Gal3-neutralizing antibody B2C10, but not by sucrose or control IgG. Gal3 bound the E protein and reduced viral attachment and internalization. In silico docking was compatible with Gal3 engagement at both E glycosylation sites, with aggregate scores favoring Asn67. Knockdown of endogenous Gal3 enhanced, and overexpression suppressed, DENV-2 replication. Gal3 also amplified NF-κB activation and the expression of IL-6, IL-8, TNF-α and IL-1β, without altering type I interferon transcripts. In vivo , infected Gal3-KO neonates showed earlier mortality, higher brain viral loads and more severe neuropathology than wild-type mice. Conclusions Gal3 restricts DENV-2 by binding the viral envelope glycoprotein and reducing viral entry, and by enhancing NF-κB-dependent pro-inflammatory responses. Gal3 deficiency worsens disease in vivo , and Gal3 is a candidate host-directed target against dengue.

title_zh: Galectin-3通过糖基依赖的包膜蛋白结合限制登革病毒感染并增强NF-κB信号传导
source_body_en: Abstract Background No antiviral therapy is approved for dengue virus (DENV). Galectin-3 (Gal3), a β-galactoside-binding lectin, modulates several viral infections, but its role in DENV pathogenesis is unknown. Material and Methods Using a GFP-tagged DENV-2 reporter virus, we evaluated the effects of recombinant Gal3, Gal3 knockdown and Gal3 overexpression. Viral attachment, internalization, NF-κB signaling and cytokine expression were analyzed, together with molecular docking of Gal3 to the DENV envelope (E) protein. Disease outcomes were assessed in intracerebrally inoculated neonatal Gal3-knockout (Gal3-KO) mice. Results DENV-2 infection down-regulated endogenous Gal3. Extracellularly, recombinant Gal3 reduced DENV-2 infectivity and progeny production in a dose-dependent manner, and conditioned medium containing cell-secreted Gal3 had a similar effect. The inhibition was reversed by lactose, and by the Gal3-neutralizing antibody B2C10, but not by sucrose or control IgG. Gal3 bound the E protein and reduced viral attachment and internalization. In silico docking was compatible with Gal3 engagement at both E glycosylation sites, with aggregate scores favoring Asn67. Knockdown of endogenous Gal3 enhanced, and overexpression suppressed, DENV-2 replication. Gal3 also amplified NF-κB activation and the expression of IL-6, IL-8, TNF-α and IL-1β, without altering type I interferon transcripts. In vivo , infected Gal3-KO neonates showed earlier mortality, higher brain viral loads and more severe neuropathology than wild-type mice. Conclusions Gal3 restricts DENV-2 by binding the viral envelope glycoprotein and reducing viral entry, and by enhancing NF-κB-dependent pro-inflammatory responses. Gal3 deficiency worsens disease in vivo , and Gal3 is a candidate host-directed target against dengue.
abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 目前尚无针对登革病毒(DENV)的获批疗法。Galectin-3(Gal3)是一种β-半乳糖苷结合凝集素,可调节多种病毒感染,但其在登革病毒感染中的作用尚不清楚。材料与方法 使用GFP标记的DENV-2报告病毒,我们评估了重组Gal3、Gal3敲低和Gal3过表达的效果。分析了病毒附着、内化、NF-κB信号传导和细胞因子表达,同时进行了Gal3与DENV包膜(E)蛋白的分子对接实验。通过脑内接种的Gal3敲除(Gal3-KO)新生小鼠评估疾病结果。结果 DENV-2感染会下调内源性Gal3。在体外,重组Gal3以剂量依赖方式减少DENV-2的感染性和子代病毒产量,含有细胞分泌Gal3的条件培养基也有类似效果。乳糖和Gal3中和抗体B2C10可逆转这种抑制作用,而蔗糖或对照IgG则不能。Gal3结合E蛋白并减少病毒附着和内化。计算机模拟对接显示Gal3可结合E蛋白的两个糖基化位点,其中聚集得分更倾向于Asn67。敲低内源性Gal3增强了DENV-2的复制,而过表达则抑制了其复制。Gal3还增强了NF-κB激活以及IL-6、IL-8、TNF-α和IL-1β的表达,而不会改变I型干扰素转录水平。在体内,感染Gal3-KO新生小鼠表现出更早的登革热症状、更高的脑病毒载量和更严重的神经病理学变化。结论 Gal3通过结合病毒包膜糖蛋白减少病毒进入,并通过增强NF-κB依赖的促炎反应来限制DENV-2感染。Gal3的缺乏会加重疾病,Gal3是针对登革病毒的潜在治疗靶点。

title: Dengue Vaccination in Children and Adolescents: Current Evidence, Safety, and Future Directions
abstract: Background: Dengue is an expanding mosquito-borne disease and a growing global health threat. Its four serotypes, changing epidemiology, and complex immune responses make vaccine development particularly challenging. This review examines dengue vaccines, with emphasis on children and adolescents. Methods: PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library were searched from inception through 10 November 2026. Clinical trials, observational studies, reviews, surveillance reports, and guidelines addressing dengue immunopathogenesis, vaccine development, efficacy, immunogenicity, safety, effectiveness, or implementation were considered. Evidence was assessed with attention to pediatric populations, age, baseline serostatus, infecting serotype, and duration of protection. Results: CYD-TDV provides moderate protection, but long-term follow-up identified an increased risk of hospitalized or severe dengue in seronegative recipients, making pre-vaccination screening central to its use. TAK-003 protects children and adolescents against virologically confirmed and hospitalized dengue, although efficacy varies by serotype and serostatus; protection against DENV-3 and DENV-4 in seronegative recipients remains uncertain. Butantan-DV showed efficacy across pediatric age groups and baseline serostatus, although the absence of DENV-3 and DENV-4 cases precluded serotype-specific estimates. Over five years, phase III rates of unsolicited vaccine-related adverse events, including serious events, were comparable with placebo. After ANVISA registered the vaccine for ages 12–59 on 8 December 2025, Brazil paused its vaccination strategy in June 2026 while investigating 42 reports following approximately 500,000 doses, including three severe cases and two deaths. Causality has not been established. TV003/TV005 and other platforms broaden the pipeline, though pediatric efficacy evidence remains limited. No validated correlate of protection is available. Affordability, equitable access, surveillance, and caregiver confidence remain important implementation challenges. Conclusions: Dengue vaccines mark important progress, but their benefits and risks depend on age, serostatus, and circulating serotypes. Long-term, serotype-specific evaluation and post-marketing surveillance are needed. Next-generation vaccines, clear communication, and sustainable access will be essential to achieve durable, equitable protection for children.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 登革热是一种不断扩展的蚊媒传染病,已成为日益严重的全球健康威胁。其四种血清型、不断变化的病毒特性以及复杂的发病机制使得疫苗研发面临特别挑战。本综述探讨了登革病毒疫苗,特别关注儿童和青少年群体。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 从数据库创建起至2026年11月10日,检索了PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Web of Science和Cochrane图书馆。评估证据时特别关注儿科人群、年龄、基线血清状态、感染血清型及保护持续时间。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: CYD-TDV提供中等程度的保护,但长期随访发现血清阴性受种者住院或重症登革热风险增加,因此在使用前进行血清学筛查至关重要。TAK-003可保护儿童和青少年免受病毒学确诊和住院的登革病毒感染,但其有效性因血清型和血清状态而异;血清阴性受种者对DENV-3和DENV-4的保护效果尚不确定。在五年期间,III期试验中未报告的疫苗相关不良事件发生率,包括严重事件,与安慰剂相当。登革病毒疫苗标志着重要进展,但其益处和风险取决于年龄、血清状态及流行血清型。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 尚无经过验证的保护相关指标。TV003/TV005及其他平台拓宽了疫苗研发管线,但针对儿童的有效性证据仍有限。目前尚未确定因果关系。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 2025年12月8日,ANVISA注册了疫苗用于12至59岁人群,巴西随后在2026年6月暂停了疫苗接种策略,以调查在接种约500,000剂后出现的42份报告,其中包括3例严重病例和2例死亡。可负担性、公平获取、监测以及护理人员信心仍然是重要的实施挑战。长期来看,需要进行针对血清型的评估以及上市后的监测监测。下一代疫苗、清晰的沟通以及可持续的获取将是实现儿童持久且公平保护的关键。

title_zh: 登革病毒疫苗在儿童和青少年中的应用:现有证据、安全性及未来方向
source_body_en: Background: Dengue is an expanding mosquito-borne disease and a growing global health threat. Its four serotypes, changing epidemiology, and complex immune responses make vaccine development particularly challenging. This review examines dengue vaccines, with emphasis on children and adolescents. Methods: PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library were searched from inception through 10 November 2026. Clinical trials, observational studies, reviews, surveillance reports, and guidelines addressing dengue immunopathogenesis, vaccine development, efficacy, immunogenicity, safety, effectiveness, or implementation were considered. Evidence was assessed with attention to pediatric populations, age, baseline serostatus, infecting serotype, and duration of protection. Results: CYD-TDV provides moderate protection, but long-term follow-up identified an increased risk of hospitalized or severe dengue in seronegative recipients, making pre-vaccination screening central to its use. TAK-003 protects children and adolescents against virologically confirmed and hospitalized dengue, although efficacy varies by serotype and serostatus; protection against DENV-3 and DENV-4 in seronegative recipients remains uncertain. Butantan-DV showed efficacy across pediatric age groups and baseline serostatus, although the absence of DENV-3 and DENV-4 cases precluded serotype-specific estimates. Over five years, phase III rates of unsolicited vaccine-related adverse events, including serious events, were comparable with placebo. After ANVISA registered the vaccine for ages 12–59 on 8 December 2025, Brazil paused its vaccination strategy in June 2026 while investigating 42 reports following approximately 500,000 doses, including three severe cases and two deaths. Causality has not been established. TV003/TV005 and other platforms broaden the pipeline, though pediatric efficacy evidence remains limited. No validated correlate of protection is available. Affordability, equitable access, surveillance, and caregiver confidence remain important implementation challenges. Conclusions: Dengue vaccines mark important progress, but their benefits and risks depend on age, serostatus, and circulating serotypes. Long-term, serotype-specific evaluation and post-marketing surveillance are needed. Next-generation vaccines, clear communication, and sustainable access will be essential to achieve durable, equitable protection for children.

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 登革热是一种不断扩展的蚊媒传染病,已成为日益严重的全球健康威胁。其四种血清型、不断变化的病毒特性以及复杂的发病机制使得疫苗研发面临特别挑战。本综述探讨了登革病毒疫苗,特别关注儿童和青少年群体。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 从数据库创建起至2026年11月10日,检索了PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Web of Science和Cochrane图书馆。评估证据时特别关注儿科人群、年龄、基线血清状态、感染血清型及保护持续时间。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: CYD-TDV提供中等程度的保护,但长期随访发现血清阴性受种者住院或重症登革热风险增加,因此在使用前进行血清学筛查至关重要。TAK-003可保护儿童和青少年免受病毒学确诊和住院的登革病毒感染,但其有效性因血清型和血清状态而异;血清阴性受种者对DENV-3和DENV-4的保护效果尚不确定。在五年期间,III期试验中未报告的疫苗相关不良事件发生率,包括严重事件,与安慰剂相当。登革病毒疫苗标志着重要进展,但其益处和风险取决于年龄、血清状态及流行血清型。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 尚无经过验证的保护相关指标。TV003/TV005及其他平台拓宽了疫苗研发管线,但针对儿童的有效性证据仍有限。目前尚未确定因果关系。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 2025年12月8日,ANVISA注册了疫苗用于12至59岁人群,巴西随后在2026年6月暂停了疫苗接种策略,以调查在接种约500,000剂后出现的42份报告,其中包括3例严重病例和2例死亡。可负担性、公平获取、监测以及护理人员信心仍然是重要的实施挑战。长期来看,需要进行针对血清型的评估以及上市后的监测监测。下一代疫苗、清晰的沟通以及可持续的获取将是实现儿童持久且公平保护的关键。

title: Co-circulation of dengue virus multiple serotypes during the 2022 outbreak in Madhesh Province, Nepal
abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) poses a significant public health threat in Nepal, with major outbreaks increasingly reported across the country’s southern plains. This study aimed to identify the circulating DENV serotypes during the 2022 dengue outbreak in Madhesh Province, Nepal. Out of the 588 non-duplicate serum samples, 17.86% exhibited probable acute-phase dengue infection profiles, while 5.95% revealed recent or late-stage DENV infection profiles. Similarly, 0.85% showed resolved DENV infection profiles, while 75.34% showed negative results for DENV infection. Among the 85 serologically positive dengue samples analysed for serotyping, DENV serotypes were detected and identified in 81.2% ( n = 69) samples. Dengue virus serotyping revealed the co-circulation of three DENV serotypes ( DENV-1, DENV-2, and DENV-3) in Madhesh Province, Nepal during the 2022 outbreak. DENV-1 was the predominant circulating serotype, accounting for 55.1% of the typed samples, followed by DENV-3 and DENV-2 as single-serotype infections. Furthermore, concurrent infection with DENV-1 and DENV-2 was detected in 13% of the typed samples. Concurrent DENV-1/DENV-2 infection was identified for the first time in Madhesh Province, with DENV-1 predominating among the multiple circulating serotypes.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究在2022年尼泊尔马德什省登革热暴发期间进行,分析了从疑似登革热感染患者中收集的588份非重复血清样本。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究采用血清学检测方法来识别可能的急性期登革热感染和近期或晚期DENV感染特征。同时,对85份血清学阳性样本进行了血清型鉴定,以确定存在的具体DENV血清型。
elements_zh.main_results: 在分析的588份非重复血清样本中,17.86%表现出可能的急性期登革热感染特征,而5.95%显示出近期或晚期DENV感染特征。同样,0.85%的样本显示出DENV感染已恢复的特征,而75.34%的样本未检测到DENV感染。在对85份血清学阳性登革热样本进行血清型鉴定时,81.2%(n=69)的样本检测并鉴定了DENV血清型。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 血清型鉴定结果显示,在2022年尼泊尔马德什省登革热暴发期间,三种DENV血清型(DENV-1、DENV-2和DENV-3)同时循环。在鉴定样本中,13%的样本同时感染了DENV-1和DENV-2。这是首次在尼泊尔马德什省检测到DENV-1/DENV-2的并发感染,且DENV-1在多种循环血清型中占主导地位。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于暴发期间收集的血清样本,这可能限制其普遍适用性。由于依赖血清学检测且未包括基因组测序或临床结果数据,证据强度中等。

title: Short-Term Forecasting of Weekly Dengue Cases in Singapore Using ARIMA and Fourier-ARIMA Models
abstract: In this paper, a clear case-only forecasting model is developed on weekly basis. Dengue in Singapore based on official surveillance data between 2012-W01 and 2026.W17. The paper questions whether the number of cases routinely reported can be useful on their own. Short-term warning information in cases when external covariates are not available or are delayed. Dengue Fever and Dengue Haemorrhagic Fever cases were aggregated on a weekly basis, converted with log(1 + cases), tested to be stationary, and modelled using Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA). And Fourier-ARIMA specifications. Candidate models were compared through residual diagnostics, information criteria, and recursive one-week-ahead validation on the final 10% of the series. ARIMA(4,1,0)+Fourier(2) was selected because it balanced point accuracy, residual adequacy, and parsimony. In the 75-week test period, the model achieved MAE of 11.6 cases and RMSE of 16.0 cases, while 90% prediction interval coverage was 80%. The framework is therefore potentially useful as interpretable and timely surveillance decision support for early warning and preparedness, but it should be combined with field intelligence and future calibration work.
journal: International Journal of Biology and Life Sciences

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop a forecasting model for dengue cases in Singapore, addressing the need for reliable short-term predictions to support public health decision-making.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A case-only forecasting model was developed using weekly dengue surveillance data from Singapore between 2012-W01 and 2026-W17, with a 75-week test period to evaluate its performance.
analysis.methods: Dengue Fever and Dengue Haemorrhagic Fever cases were aggregated weekly, converted using log(1 + cases), tested for stationarity, and modelled with Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) and Fourier-ARIMA specifications.
analysis.main_results: The model achieved a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 11.6 cases and a Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of 16.0 cases, with 90% prediction interval coverage of 80% during the test period.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The ARIMA(4,1,0)+Fourier(2) model was selected for its balance of point accuracy, residual adequacy, and model simplicity, offering a novel approach for short-term dengue case forecasting.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The framework provides interpretable and timely surveillance decision support for early warning and preparedness, which can inform public health strategies in dengue-prone regions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to short-term forecasting and does not account for external covariates, which may affect model accuracy. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the reliance on historical surveillance data.

analysis.summary_en: This study developed a weekly forecasting model for dengue cases in Singapore using ARIMA and Fourier-ARIMA methods. The model was based on official surveillance data from 2012-W01 to 2026-W17 and evaluated over a 75-week test period. Dengue Fever and Dengue Haemorrhagic Fever cases were aggregated weekly, transformed with log(1 + cases), and tested for stationarity. The model achieved a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 11.6 cases and a Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of 16.0 cases, with 90% prediction interval coverage of 80%. The ARIMA(4,1,0)+Fourier(2) model was selected for its balance of accuracy, residual adequacy, and simplicity. The framework offers potential for early warning and preparedness but requires integration with field intelligence and further calibration. The study's limitations include reliance on historical data and lack of external covariates, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该框架提供了可解释且及时的监测决策支持,可用于早期预警和准备,从而为登革热高发地区制定公共卫生策略提供信息。

abstract_zh: 本文开发了一个基于每周数据的清晰病例仅预报模型。该模型使用新加坡官方的登革热数据,时间范围为2012-W01至2026-W17,用于预测登革热病例。论文质疑常规报告的病例数量是否可以单独作为有用的信息。当外部协变量不可用或延迟时,模型可以提供短期预警信息。监测和登革热出血病例被汇总为每周数据,通过log(1 + 病例)进行转换,检验其平稳性,并使用自回归积分滑动平均(ARIMA)模型进行建模,同时采用傅里叶-ARIMA规格。候选模型通过残差诊断、信息标准以及对系列最后10%数据的递归一周预测验证进行比较。最终选择ARIMA(4,1,0)+傅里叶(2)模型,因为它在点准确度、残差充分性和模型简洁性之间取得了平衡。在75周的测试期间,该模型实现了11.6例的平均绝对误差(MAE)和16.0例的均方根误差(RMSE),同时90%的预测区间覆盖率为80%。因此,该框架可能作为可解释且及时的监测决策支持系统,用于早期预警和准备,但应结合现场情报和未来的校准工作。

title: Climate shapes mosquito-borne disease transmission in africa: a scoping review of climatic determinants, biological responses and transmission dynamics
abstract: Abstract Background Mosquito-borne diseases remain a major public-health challenge in Africa, and their transmission is strongly influenced by climatic conditions. However, the evidence is geographically uneven and methodologically heterogeneous. Objective To map and synthesise evidence on the influence of temperature, rainfall/precipitation and relative humidity on mosquito-borne disease transmission in Africa, and to compare climatic patterns across major vector–pathogen systems. Methods A scoping review was conducted following PRISMA-ScR. Peer-reviewed primary studies conducted in Africa, or providing identifiable Africa-specific evidence, were included if they investigated malaria, dengue, chikungunya or Zika and assessed temperature, rainfall/precipitation and/or relative humidity in relation to biological, entomological, ecological, transmission-related or epidemiological outcomes. Results Eighteen primary studies were included: 10 on malaria, 6 on dengue and 2 on Zika; none specifically addressed chikungunya. Temperature was the most frequently assessed exposure. Malaria studies showed non-linear and context-dependent temperature relationships, including a field peak in malaria positivity near 25 °C. Dengue studies showed heterogeneous temperature signals, including stronger temperature–incidence relationships above approximately 21 °C and increased transmission-related outcomes around 29–30 °C in specific settings. Rainfall generally increased vector abundance or malaria transmission, although excessive rainfall sometimes reduced larval survival or dengue transmission. Relative humidity showed context-dependent effects, including trade-offs between Aedes aegypti survival and Zika virus infection. Reported climatic lags ranged mainly from one to four months. Conclusion Climatic influences on mosquito-borne disease transmission in Africa are non-linear, disease-specific and context-dependent. Stronger climate-informed surveillance and locally resolved integrated research are needed.

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 蚊媒疾病仍然是非洲公共卫生的主要挑战,其传播受气候条件的强烈影响。然而,现有证据在地理分布和方法学上存在不均衡和异质性。目的 映射和综合非洲蚊媒疾病传播受温度、降雨/降水量和相对湿度影响的证据,并比较主要媒介-病原体系统中的气候模式。方法 采用PRISMA-ScR框架进行综述。纳入标准为在非洲进行或提供可识别非洲特异性证据的同行评审原始研究,这些研究调查了疟疾、登革热、基孔肯雅热或寨卡病毒,并评估了温度、降雨/降水量和/或相对湿度与生物、病媒、生态、传播相关或流行病学结果的关系。结果 共纳入18项原始研究:10项关于疟疾,6项关于登革热,2项关于寨卡病毒;没有专门针对基孔肯雅热的研究。温度是最常评估的暴露因素。疟疾研究显示温度与传播之间的非线性且情境依赖关系,包括在接近25 °C时疟疾阳性率出现峰值。登革热研究显示温度信号的异质性,包括在约21 °C以上时温度与发病率之间的关系更强,以及在特定情境下29–30 °C时传播相关结果增加。降雨通常会增加媒介的丰度或疟疾传播,但过量降雨有时会降低幼虫存活率或登革热传播。相对湿度表现出情境依赖效应,包括Aedes aegypti存活与寨卡病毒感染之间的权衡。报告的气候滞后时间主要在1至4个月之间。结论 非洲蚊媒疾病传播的气候影响是非线性的、疾病特异的和情境依赖的。需要更强的气候导向监测和本地化的整合研究。

title: Climate-driven Spatiotemporal Dynamics of Dengue Transmission in Southern Brazil: Integrating Entomological Surveillance and Random Forest Prediction
abstract: Abstract Climatic variability is closely linked to dengue transmission; however, its integration with entomological surveillance and machine-learning models remains poorly explored in subtropical regions of South America. This study evaluated the predictive performance of Random Forest models combining meteorological variables, entomological surveillance data, and lagged epidemiological series to predict dengue transmission across four distinct subtropical municipalities in Santa Catarina, southern Brazil, during 2014–2023. Entomo-epidemiological data were obtained from the Diretoria de Vigilância Epidemiológica de Santa Catarina (DIVE/SC), while climate data (temperature and precipitation) were obtained from the Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas Espaciais (INPE) and the National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP). The Artificial Intelligence approach was implemented in Python 3, to predict dengue cases based on climatological elements, vector proliferation (breeding sites), and lagged epidemiological data. Spatiotemporal analysis revealed marked regional heterogeneity: dengue transmission was concentrated in coastal and western zones within optimal vector thermal ranges (22°C–32°C), with epidemic peaks occurring earlier in the western region (weeks 12–16 in Chapecó) than on the coast (weeks 16–20). Therefore, predictive performance varied substantially across regions, achieving high accuracy in Chapecó (R2 = 0.82) but lower efficacy in Florianópolis (R2 = 0.38). Crucially, the models exhibited a systematic underestimation of extreme epidemic outbreaks when high-incidence historical data were absent from the training sets. These findings demonstrate that regional climatic heterogeneity strongly conditions dengue dynamics, highlighting that locally calibrated predictive models are essential to enhance early warning systems and guide One Health surveillance strategies in subtropical zones.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to evaluate the predictive performance of Random Forest models integrating meteorological variables, entomological surveillance data, and lagged epidemiological series to forecast dengue transmission in subtropical regions of southern Brazil. The research was motivated by the need to better understand how climate variability influences dengue dynamics, particularly in areas where such integration remains underexplored.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted across four subtropical municipalities in Santa Catarina, southern Brazil, from 2014 to 2023. It involved the analysis of entomo-epidemiological data and climate data to assess dengue transmission patterns and model performance.
analysis.methods: Entomo-epidemiological data were sourced from DIVE/SC, while climate data (temperature and precipitation) were obtained from INPE and NCEP. The Artificial Intelligence approach was implemented in Python 3 to predict dengue cases based on climatological elements, vector proliferation (breeding sites), and lagged epidemiological data.
analysis.main_results: Spatiotemporal analysis revealed marked regional heterogeneity, with dengue transmission concentrated in coastal and western zones within optimal vector thermal ranges (22°C–32°C). Epidemic peaks occurred earlier in the western region (weeks 12–16 in Chapecó) than on the coast (weeks 16–20). Predictive performance varied substantially across regions, achieving high accuracy in Chapecó (R2 = 0.82) but lower efficacy in Florianópolis (R2 = 0.38).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that regional climatic heterogeneity strongly conditions dengue dynamics, highlighting the necessity of locally calibrated predictive models to enhance early warning systems and guide One Health surveillance strategies in subtropical zones.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results can inform the development of more accurate predictive models for dengue transmission, aiding in the design of targeted surveillance and intervention strategies in subtropical regions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The models exhibited a systematic underestimation of extreme epidemic outbreaks when high-incidence historical data were absent from the training sets, indicating limitations in predictive accuracy under certain conditions. The evidence strength is moderate due to the reliance on historical data and the potential for underestimation in scenarios with limited data availability.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the spatiotemporal dynamics of dengue transmission in southern Brazil, focusing on how climate variability interacts with entomological surveillance data to predict outbreaks. The research highlights the importance of integrating meteorological variables, vector proliferation, and lagged epidemiological data into predictive models. The study was conducted across four subtropical municipalities in Santa Catarina from 2014 to 2023, using data from DIVE/SC, INPE, and NCEP. The results show significant regional differences in dengue transmission patterns, with higher accuracy in Chapecó compared to Florianópolis. The models underperformed in predicting extreme outbreaks when historical data were sparse, suggesting the need for locally calibrated approaches. The findings emphasize the role of climate in shaping dengue dynamics and the value of predictive models in enhancing early warning systems and One Health strategies. However, the study's reliance on historical data and its limited scope to subtropical regions may affect the generalizability of its conclusions.

analysis_en.methods: Entomo-epidemiological data were sourced from DIVE/SC, while climate data (temperature and precipitation) were obtained from INPE and NCEP. The Artificial Intelligence approach was implemented in Python 3 to predict dengue cases based on climatological elements, vector proliferation (breeding sites), and lagged epidemiological data.

Epidemic peaks occurred earlier in the western region (weeks 12–16 in Chapecó) than on the coast (weeks 16–20). analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that regional climatic heterogeneity strongly conditions dengue dynamics, highlighting the necessity of locally calibrated predictive models to enhance early warning systems and guide One Health surveillance strategies in subtropical zones.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results can inform the development of more accurate predictive models for dengue transmission, aiding in the design of targeted surveillance and intervention strategies in subtropical regions.

title_zh: 气候驱动的巴西南部登革热传播时空动态:整合昆虫学监测与随机森林预测
source_body_en: Abstract Climatic variability is closely linked to dengue transmission; however, its integration with entomological surveillance and machine-learning models remains poorly explored in subtropical regions of South America. This study evaluated the predictive performance of Random Forest models combining meteorological variables, entomological surveillance data, and lagged epidemiological series to predict dengue transmission across four distinct subtropical municipalities in Santa Catarina, southern Brazil, during 2014–2023. Entomo-epidemiological data were obtained from the Diretoria de Vigilância Epidemiológica de Santa Catarina (DIVE/SC), while climate data (temperature and precipitation) were obtained from the Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas Espaciais (INPE) and the National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP). The Artificial Intelligence approach was implemented in Python 3, to predict dengue cases based on climatological elements, vector proliferation (breeding sites), and lagged epidemiological data. Spatiotemporal analysis revealed marked regional heterogeneity: dengue transmission was concentrated in coastal and western zones within optimal vector thermal ranges (22°C–32°C), with epidemic peaks occurring earlier in the western region (weeks 12–16 in Chapecó) than on the coast (weeks 16–20). Therefore, predictive performance varied substantially across regions, achieving high accuracy in Chapecó (R2 = 0.82) but lower efficacy in Florianópolis (R2 = 0.38). Crucially, the models exhibited a systematic underestimation of extreme epidemic outbreaks when high-incidence historical data were absent from the training sets. These findings demonstrate that regional climatic heterogeneity strongly conditions dengue dynamics, highlighting that locally calibrated predictive models are essential to enhance early warning systems and guide One Health surveillance strategies in subtropical zones.
abstract_zh: 摘要气候变异性与登革热传播密切相关;然而,在南美洲亚热带地区,其与昆虫学监测数据和机器学习模型的整合仍鲜有研究。本研究评估了结合气象变量、昆虫学监测数据和滞后流行病学系列的随机森林模型在巴西南部圣卡塔琳娜州四个不同亚热带市镇(2014–2023年)预测登革热传播的预测性能。昆虫-流行病学数据来自圣卡塔琳娜州流行病学监测局(DIVE/SC),气候数据(温度和降水)来自巴西国家空间研究机构(INPE)和美国国家环境预测中心(NCEP)。人工智能方法在Python 3中实现,以基于气候要素、媒介繁殖(繁殖地)和滞后流行病学数据预测登革热病例。时空分析揭示了显著的区域异质性:登革热传播集中在沿海和西部地区,在最佳媒介热范围内(22°C–32°C)。在Chapecó市,西部地区的疫情高峰出现在第12–16周,而沿海地区则出现在第16–20周。因此,不同地区的预测性能差异显著,Chapecó市的预测准确度较高(R2 = 0.82),而Florianópolis市的预测效果较低(R2 = 0.38)。值得注意的是,当训练集缺乏高发病率历史数据时,模型对极端疫情暴发存在系统性低估。这些发现表明,区域气候异质性强烈影响登革热动态,强调在亚热带地区开发本地校准的预测模型对于提升早期预警系统和指导One Health 监测策略的重要性。

title: Serum Cortisol and Lipid Profile as Predictors of Dengue Severity in Children: A Prospective Observational Study
abstract: Introduction: Early prediction of severe dengue in children continues to be difficult, even with World Health Organisation (WHO) warning signs. Alterations in stress hormones and lipid metabolism have been associated with dengue severity; however, prospective paediatric data are limited. Serum cortisol and lipid profile are routinely available laboratory parameters and may provide additional information regarding disease severity. Aim: To evaluate the significance of serum cortisol and lipid profile in forecasting the advancement to severe dengue in children. Materials and Methods: This prospective observational study was conducted in the Department of Paediatrics, SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre, Kattankulathur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, over two years (July 2024-July 2026). A total of 90 dengue NS1 or IgM ELISA-positive children aged between 0-14 years with warning signs and presenting between days 3 and 7 of illness were enrolled after informed consent. Serum cortisol and fasting lipid profile were measured at enrolment, and the day of illness at sampling was recorded. Children were classified according to subsequent progression to severe dengue. Categorical variables were compared using the Chisquare test and continuous variables using the independentsamples t-test; p-value <0.05 was considered statistically significant. Results: In the present study, 15 out of 90 (16.67%) children progressed to severe dengue. Boys constituted 57/90 (63.33%) of the cohort, and the largest age group was 1-5 years (32/90; 35.56%). Fluid accumulation, mucosal bleeding, lethargy, and significant liver enlargement were significantly associated with progression to severe dengue. Severe dengue was also associated with higher total leucocyte count and serum urea, lower serum sodium and bicarbonate, and prolonged prothrombin time. Mean serum cortisol was higher in children who progressed to severe dengue than in those who did not (18.74±6.14 vs 15.46±4.48 μg/dL; p-value =0.017). Mean triglyceride levels were also higher (220.07±141.71 vs 162.97±62.69 mg/dL; p-value =0.014), whereas mean total cholesterol levels were lower (99.67±23.70 vs 122.01±26.71 mg/dL; p-value =0.003). Very Low-Density Lipoprotein (VLDL), Low-Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol (LDL-C), and High-Density Lipoprotein (HDL) levels did not differ significantly between groups. Conclusion: High levels of cortisol and triglycerides with low levels of total cholesterol at the time of admission are strongly linked to the development of severe dengue.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 即使有世界卫生组织(WHO)的警告信号,儿童登革热严重程度的早期预测仍然困难。血清皮质醇和脂质谱是常规的实验室参数,可能提供有关疾病严重程度的额外信息。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本前瞻性观察性研究在印度泰米尔纳德邦金奈卡坦库拉特的SRM医学院医院和研究中心儿科部门进行,为期两年(2024年7月至2026年7月)。在获得知情同意后,共纳入了90名登革热NS1或IgM ELISA阳性、年龄在0-14岁之间、出现警告信号且在发病第3至第7天就诊的儿童。
elements_zh.methods: 在入组时测量了血清皮质醇和空腹脂质谱,并记录了采样时的发病天数。分类变量采用卡方检验,连续变量采用独立样本t检验;p值<0.05被认为具有统计学意义。
elements_zh.main_results: 在本研究中,90名儿童中有15名(16.67%)发展为登革热严重程度。发展为登革热严重程度的儿童其血清皮质醇水平平均较高(18.74±6.14 vs 15.46±4.48 μg/dL;p值=0.017)。甘油三酯水平也较高(220.07±141.71 vs 162.97±62.69 mg/dL;p值=0.014),而总胆固醇水平较低(99.67±23.70 vs 122.01±26.71 mg/dL;p值=0.003)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 入院时皮质醇和甘油三酯水平高而总胆固醇水平低,与登革热严重程度的发展有强烈关联。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,血清皮质醇和脂质谱的测量可能作为早期识别发展为登革热严重程度风险儿童的潜在生物标志物,有助于针对性的临床管理。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其观察性设计和潜在的混杂因素,但由于使用了统计检验和明确的登革热严重程度定义,证据是强有力的。

title_zh: 儿童登革热严重程度的预测:血清皮质醇和脂质谱作为预测因子的前瞻性观察性研究
source_body_en: Introduction: Early prediction of severe dengue in children continues to be difficult, even with World Health Organisation (WHO) warning signs. Alterations in stress hormones and lipid metabolism have been associated with dengue severity; however, prospective paediatric data are limited. Serum cortisol and lipid profile are routinely available laboratory parameters and may provide additional information regarding disease severity. Aim: To evaluate the significance of serum cortisol and lipid profile in forecasting the advancement to severe dengue in children. Materials and Methods: This prospective observational study was conducted in the Department of Paediatrics, SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre, Kattankulathur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, over two years (July 2024-July 2026). A total of 90 dengue NS1 or IgM ELISA-positive children aged between 0-14 years with warning signs and presenting between days 3 and 7 of illness were enrolled after informed consent. Serum cortisol and fasting lipid profile were measured at enrolment, and the day of illness at sampling was recorded. Children were classified according to subsequent progression to severe dengue. Categorical variables were compared using the Chisquare test and continuous variables using the independentsamples t-test; p-value <0.05 was considered statistically significant. Results: In the present study, 15 out of 90 (16.67%) children progressed to severe dengue. Boys constituted 57/90 (63.33%) of the cohort, and the largest age group was 1-5 years (32/90; 35.56%). Fluid accumulation, mucosal bleeding, lethargy, and significant liver enlargement were significantly associated with progression to severe dengue. Severe dengue was also associated with higher total leucocyte count and serum urea, lower serum sodium and bicarbonate, and prolonged prothrombin time. Mean serum cortisol was higher in children who progressed to severe dengue than in those who did not (18.74±6.14 vs 15.46±4.48 μg/dL; p-value =0.017). Mean triglyceride levels were also higher (220.07±141.71 vs 162.97±62.69 mg/dL; p-value =0.014), whereas mean total cholesterol levels were lower (99.67±23.70 vs 122.01±26.71 mg/dL; p-value =0.003). Very Low-Density Lipoprotein (VLDL), Low-Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol (LDL-C), and High-Density Lipoprotein (HDL) levels did not differ significantly between groups. Conclusion: High levels of cortisol and triglycerides with low levels of total cholesterol at the time of admission are strongly linked to the development of severe dengue.
abstract_zh: 引言:即使有世界卫生组织(WHO)的警告信号,儿童登革热严重程度的早期预测仍然困难。压力激素和脂质代谢的变化与登革热严重程度有关,但前瞻性儿科数据有限。血清皮质醇和脂质谱是常规的实验室参数,可能提供有关疾病严重程度的额外信息。目的:评估血清皮质醇和脂质谱在预测儿童发展为登革热严重程度中的意义。材料与方法:本前瞻性观察性研究在印度泰米尔纳德邦金奈卡坦库拉特的SRM医学院医院和研究中心儿科部门进行,为期两年(2024年7月至2026年7月)。在获得知情同意后,共纳入了90名登革热NS1或IgM ELISA阳性、年龄在0-14岁之间、出现警告信号且在发病第3至第7天就诊的儿童。在入组时测量了血清皮质醇和空腹脂质谱,并记录了采样时的发病天数。根据后续发展为登革热严重程度对儿童进行分类。分类变量采用卡方检验,连续变量采用独立样本t检验;p值<0.05被认为具有统计学意义。结果:在本研究中,90名儿童中有15名(16.67%)发展为登革热严重程度。发展为登革热严重程度的儿童中,男孩占57/90(63.33%),最大年龄组为1-5岁(32/90;35.56%)。液体积聚、黏膜出血、嗜睡和显著肝脏肿大与发展为登革热严重程度显著相关。登革热严重程度还与较高的总白细胞计数和血清尿素、较低的血清钠和碳酸氢盐水平以及延长的凝血酶原时间有关。发展为登革热严重程度的儿童其血清皮质醇水平平均较高(18.74±6.14 vs 15.46±4.48 μg/dL;p值=0.017)。甘油三酯水平也较高(220.07±141.71 vs 162.97±62.69 mg/dL;p值=0.014),而总胆固醇水平较低(99.67±23.70 vs 122.01±26.71 mg/dL;p值=0.003)。极低密度脂蛋白(VLDL)、低密度脂蛋白胆固醇(LDL-C)和高密度脂蛋白(HDL)水平在两组之间没有显著差异。结论:入院时皮质醇和甘油三酯水平高而总胆固醇水平低,与登革热严重程度的发展有强烈关联。

title: Coinciding Neurological Sequelae in Dengue: Guillain–Barré Syndrome and ADEM
abstract: Abstract Severe dengue infection can involve the central and peripheral nervous systems, leading to varied neurological manifestations. Dengue-associated Landry-Guillain–Barré syndrome (L-GBS) is a seldom reported and unusual neurological manifestation. L-GBS has been associated with many viral agents, but its association with dengue virus is rare. We are presenting a case of an 11-year-old male who initially exhibited fever, tingling sensations, and weakness in both upper and lower limbs by the third day of illness. Subsequently, he developed seizures and experienced altered mental status. He was managed as dengue meningoencephalitis, but quadriparesis was persistent even after improvement of sensorium. Nerve conduction velocity testing was done, which was evident of axonal neuropathy, and magnetic resonance imaging showed white matter in involvement, suggestive of demyelinating process. Thus, he was diagnosed with dengue-associated acute demyelinating encephalomyelitis and L-GBS. He was treated with immunotherapy and was discharged with a power of 3/5 in bilateral limbs.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to highlight the rare neurological complications associated with dengue infection, specifically the occurrence of Landry-Guillain–Barré syndrome (L-GBS) and acute demyelinating encephalomyelitis (ADEM) in a pediatric patient. Dengue virus can lead to severe neurological manifestations, which are not commonly reported in the literature.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This case report describes an 11-year-old male patient with dengue infection who developed neurological symptoms including fever, tingling, weakness, seizures, and altered mental status. The study is based on a single clinical case observed in a hospital setting.
analysis.methods: The patient was managed as dengue meningoencephalitis, and diagnostic procedures included nerve conduction velocity testing and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) to assess neurological involvement. These tests were used to identify axonal neuropathy and white matter changes indicative of a demyelinating process.
analysis.main_results: Nerve conduction velocity testing revealed axonal neuropathy, and MRI showed white matter involvement, suggesting a demyelinating process. The patient was diagnosed with dengue-associated acute demyelinating encephalomyelitis and Landry-Guillain–Barré syndrome (L-GBS).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that dengue virus can cause rare but severe neurological complications such as ADEM and L-GBS, which are not typically associated with dengue infection. This case adds to the understanding of the diverse neurological outcomes of dengue.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study provides important insights into the neurological complications of dengue, emphasizing the need for heightened awareness and further research into the mechanisms and management of such rare manifestations.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a single case report, which may not be representative of broader trends. However, the evidence is strong given the detailed clinical and diagnostic findings, and the case is relevant to understanding dengue's neurological impact.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes an 11-year-old male with dengue infection who developed neurological symptoms including fever, tingling, weakness, seizures, and altered mental status. Diagnostic procedures such as nerve conduction velocity testing and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) revealed axonal neuropathy and white matter involvement, leading to a diagnosis of dengue-associated acute demyelinating encephalomyelitis and Landry-Guillain–Barré syndrome (L-GBS). The findings highlight the rare but severe neurological complications that can arise from dengue infection, underscoring the need for increased awareness and further research into these manifestations. The study is based on a single case, which limits generalizability, but the detailed clinical and diagnostic evidence supports the significance of the reported outcomes.

title: Virus del dengue: Aspectos epidemiológicos, clasificación e implicaciones clínicas en el paciente pediátrico
abstract: INTRODUCCIÓN: El virus del dengue, un arbovirus transmitido por artrópodos del género Aedes, del cual circulan hasta 4 serotipos principalmente en regiones tropicales y subtropicales; con reporte de aumento de casos cada año. La última clasificación según la Organización Mundial de la Salud se refiere a dengue con o sin signos de alarma y dengue grave, aunque afecta a personas de cualquier edad, los niños y adolescentes tienen mayor riesgo de desarrollar formas graves, así también las personas con comorbilidad. OBJETIVO: Generar una revisión actualizada de los principales aspectos epidemiológicos, clasificación e implicaciones clínicas y de prevención del virus del dengue en el paciente pediátrico. RELEVANCIA: La evidencia sobre la enfermedad del dengue que involucra niños es escasa, con reportes epidemiológicos que datan más de una década; y no describen las implicaciones de las formas graves del virus del dengue en el grupo pediátrico que tienen mayor riesgo de hospitalización por complicaciones relacionadas con alteraciones de la permeabilidad vascular, hemostasia, trombocitopenia entre otras que sugieren daño a órganos diana y choque; es decir, las complejas interacciones entre el virus del dengue, el sistema inmunitario y los factores propios del huésped determinan el nivel de gravedad de la enfermedad en niños y adolescentes con aumento del riesgo de hospitalización y mortalidad.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the lack of updated information on the epidemiological aspects, classification and clinical implications of dengue virus in pediatric patients, given the increasing number of cases reported annually.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a review of the current evidence on dengue virus in pediatric patients, focusing on epidemiological data, classification criteria and clinical implications, with an emphasis on the risk factors associated with severe forms of the disease.
analysis.methods: The study involved a comprehensive review of existing literature on dengue virus, with a focus on pediatric populations, including epidemiological data, classification systems and clinical outcomes related to severe dengue.
analysis.main_results: The evidence highlights that dengue disease in children is associated with a higher risk of hospitalization and mortality due to complications such as vascular permeability, hemostasis, thrombocytopenia and organ damage.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the severity of dengue in children is influenced by complex interactions between the virus, the immune system and host factors, which is a novel perspective in understanding pediatric dengue outcomes.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform improved surveillance, diagnosis and prevention strategies for dengue in children, particularly in identifying risk factors for severe disease and guiding clinical management.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on existing literature, which may have limited recent data, and the evidence is considered moderate due to the reliance on observational reports rather than experimental data.

analysis.summary_en: This study provides an updated review of the epidemiological aspects, classification and clinical implications of dengue virus in pediatric patients. It emphasizes the increased risk of severe dengue, hospitalization and mortality in children compared to adults, highlighting the complex interactions between the virus, immune system and host factors. The authors suggest that these interactions determine the severity of the disease in children. The study is based on existing literature, which may have limited recent data, and the evidence is considered moderate. The findings have implications for improving surveillance, diagnosis and prevention strategies for dengue in children, particularly in identifying risk factors for severe disease and guiding clinical management.

title_zh: 登革病毒:流行病学、分类及在儿科患者中的临床意义
source_body_en: INTRODUCCIÓN: El virus del dengue, un arbovirus transmitido por artrópodos del género Aedes, del cual circulan hasta 4 serotipos principalmente en regiones tropicales y subtropicales; con reporte de aumento de casos cada año. La última clasificación según la Organización Mundial de la Salud se refiere a dengue con o sin signos de alarma y dengue grave, aunque afecta a personas de cualquier edad, los niños y adolescentes tienen mayor riesgo de desarrollar formas graves, así también las personas con comorbilidad. OBJETIVO: Generar una revisión actualizada de los principales aspectos epidemiológicos, clasificación e implicaciones clínicas y de prevención del virus del dengue en el paciente pediátrico. RELEVANCIA: La evidencia sobre la enfermedad del dengue que involucra niños es escasa, con reportes epidemiológicos que datan más de una década; y no describen las implicaciones de las formas graves del virus del dengue en el grupo pediátrico que tienen mayor riesgo de hospitalización por complicaciones relacionadas con alteraciones de la permeabilidad vascular, hemostasia, trombocitopenia entre otras que sugieren daño a órganos diana y choque; es decir, las complejas interacciones entre el virus del dengue, el sistema inmunitario y los factores propios del huésped determinan el nivel de gravedad de la enfermedad en niños y adolescentes con aumento del riesgo de hospitalización y mortalidad.
abstract_zh: 引言:登革病毒是一种由伊蚊属节肢动物传播的虫媒病毒,主要在热带和亚热带地区传播,有4种主要血清型;每年报告的病例数量呈上升趋势。根据世界卫生组织的最新分类,登革病分为有警告症状的登革病和无警告症状的登革病,以及重症登革病。尽管该病可影响任何年龄段的人群,但儿童和青少年更容易发展为重症形式,尤其是那些有合并症的患者。目标:生成一份关于登革病毒在儿科患者中的主要流行病学、分类及临床和预防方面的最新综述。相关性:关于涉及儿童的登革病的证据较为有限,且流行病学报告已有十多年的历史;这些报告并未充分描述登革病毒重症形式在儿科群体中的影响,这些形式与因血管通透性、止血、血小板减少等改变而导致的住院风险增加有关,提示了靶器官损伤和休克的可能;也就是说,登革病毒、免疫系统和宿主自身因素之间的复杂相互作用决定了儿童和青少年登革病的严重程度,增加了住院和死亡的风险。研究问题与背景:本研究旨在解决关于登革病毒在儿科患者中的流行病学特征、分类及临床意义的更新信息缺乏问题,鉴于每年报告的病例数量不断增加。研究设计与人群:本研究是对登革病毒在儿科患者中现有证据的综述,重点在于流行病学数据、分类标准及临床意义,特别强调与重症形式相关的风险因素。方法:本研究对现有文献进行了全面回顾,重点关注儿科人群,包括登革病毒的流行病学数据、分类系统及与登革病毒相关的临床结果。主要结果:证据表明,儿童登革病与因血管通透性、止血、血小板减少及器官损伤等并发症导致的住院率和死亡率增加有关。解释与创新性:作者认为,登革病毒在儿童中的严重程度受到病毒、免疫系统及宿主自身因素之间复杂相互作用的影响,这是理解儿科登革病结果的一个新颖视角。科学与公共卫生意义:这些发现可以用于改善登革病毒在儿童中的诊断、治疗和预防策略,特别是在识别重症疾病的风险因素和指导临床管理方面。局限性与证据强度:本研究基于现有文献,可能缺乏最新的数据,且由于依赖观察性报告而非实验数据,证据被认为是中等强度的。

title: Đáp ứng kháng thể (IgM/IgG) theo thời gian và mối liên quan giữa tình trạng nhiễm với một số chỉ số huyết học và lâm sàng ở bệnh nhân sốt xuất huyết dengue nội trú tại Bệnh viện 199 Đà Nẵng, 2023–2024
abstract: Tại các khu vực lưu hành dịch sốt huyết Dengue (SXHD) cao như Đà Nẵng, sự biến đổi nhanh chóng của động học vi rút – kháng thể, và hiện tượng kháng thể IgG xuất hiện sớm ở bệnh nhân nhiễm thứ phát thường gây khó khăn trong chẩn đoán sớm cũng như tiên lượng bệnh. Nghiên cứu này nhằm mục tiêu là mô tả đáp ứng kháng thể (IgM/IgG) theo thời gian và phân tích mối liên quan giữa tình trạng nhiễm với một số chỉ số huyết học và lâm sàng ở người bệnh SXHD tại Bệnh viện 199, Đà Nẵng, giai đoạn 2023-2024. Nghiên cứu theo dõi dọc được thực hiện trên 128 người bệnh SXHD, gồm 42 trường hợp (32,8%) nhiễm tiên phát và 86 trường hợp (67,2%) nhiễm thứ phát. Mẫu huyết thanh giai đoạn cấp (M1) và giai đoạn hồi phục (M2, n=107) được xét nghiệm bằng Realtime RT-PCR (dương tính khi Ct ≤ 38), MAC-ELISA (IgM) và GAC-ELISA (IgG). Tình trạng nhiễm được phân loại theo tiêu chuẩn của WHO dựa trên mẫu M1: nhiễm thứ phát khi IgG dương tính, nhiễm tiên phát khi IgG âm tính. Kết quả cho thấy, trong 5 ngày đầu khởi phát (ngày 1–5), Realtime RT-PCR đạt tỷ lệ phát hiện 87,0% (94/108; 95% CI: 79,2–92,7), trong khi tỷ lệ dương tính với IgM chỉ đạt 22,6%. Tỷ lệ dương tính với IgM thấp ở giai đoạn cấp có thể liên quan đến đáp ứng IgG sớm (66,7% mẫu M1 dương tính với IgG) ở nhóm nhiễm thứ phát. Người bệnh nhiễm thứ phát có số lượng tiểu cầu trung bình thấp hơn (56,4 ± 22,8 × 103/mm3; 95% CI: 51,5–61,3) và chỉ số Hematocrit trung bình cao hơn (46,5 ± 4,2%; 95% CI: 45,6–47,4) so với nhóm nhiễm tiên phát (p<0,001). Tỷ lệ IgG đạt 91,8% ở giai đoạn hồi phục sau ngày thứ 8. Nhiễm Dengue thứ phát chiếm ưu thế tại Bệnh viện 199, sự xuất hiện sớm của IgG trong pha cấp có liên quan đến một số biểu hiện huyết học ở người bệnh.

title: Solanaceae-derived spirostane saponins inhibit dengue virus replication and remodel host-cell metabolism
abstract: Flaviviruses reprogram host-cell metabolism to support viral replication. In previous work, we showed that Solanaceae-derived spirostane saponins inhibit dengue virus replication and were predicted to interact with viral enzymes. Here, we investigated whether S01, a purified solid from Solanum ovalifolium containing predominantly two characterized spirostane saponins, also modulates host-cell metabolism in association with reduced permissiveness to dengue virus serotype 2 (DENV-2). We performed untargeted GC-QTOF-MS metabolomics in Vero cells under four conditions, including untreated control, S01 treatment, DENV-2 infection, and DENV-2 infection with S01 treatment. Quality-control samples clustered tightly, supporting analytical reproducibility. Principal component analysis revealed separation among experimental groups, and PERMANOVA confirmed significant global metabolic differences (F = 27.567, R{superscript 2} = 0.827, p = 0.001). S01 also retained strong antiviral activity, producing 99.9% inhibition under the metabolomics conditions. DENV-2 infection was associated with alterations metabolites related to amino acid, carbohydrate, lipid, and sphingolipid metabolism. Pathway analysis highlighted glutamate metabolism, arginine and proline metabolism, glycolysis-related pathways, fatty-acid oxidation and carnitine-associated metabolism, phosphatidylcholine biosynthesis, and sphingolipid metabolism. In uninfected cells, S01 induced a distinct metabolic profile (OPLS-DA R{superscript 2}Y = 0.951, Q{superscript 2} = 0.851; permutation p = 0.002), characterized by increased carbohydrate-related metabolites, including the unresolved Talose/D-glucose feature, gluconic acid, 2-keto-L-gulonic acid, and D-mannitol, together with decreased abundance of selected lipid-related metabolites. During infection, S01 induced a distinct metabolic (OPLS-DA R{superscript 2}Y = 0.928, Q{superscript 2} = 0.841), characterized by lower abundance of several fatty-acid-related and organic-acid metabolites and higher abundance of carbohydrate-related metabolites, while modifying selected DENV-2-associated metabolic alterations. These findings associate S01 antiviral activity with substantial remodeling of host-cell metabolism. Together with previous docking predictions of interactions with viral targets, the results support a model in which the antiviral activity of Solanaceae-derived spirostane saponins may involve complementary effects on viral and host-associated processes.

title: Environmental Health Approaches to Dengue Vector Control: A Mixed-Methods Review of Marigold, Fermented Ovitraps, and Community-Based Monitoring
abstract: Background: Community participation is central to dengue prevention, but evidence for educational promotion of live marigold and fermented ovitraps is heterogeneous. Objective: To critically synthesize available educational, laboratory and field observations and propose appropriately matched environmental-health indicators. Methods: A focused, purposively assembled mixed-evidence narrative review considered 15 categorized sources; database searches and selection counts were not documented, and no meta-analysis was attempted. Results: Among 400 volunteers, positive attitudes were associated with prevention practices (OR 1.69). In a school study, reported knowledge scores rose from 57.18 to 82.84 and practice scores from 55.64 to 79.74, but the source reports conflicting sample sizes (60 versus 90). A marigold flower fraction showed laboratory larvicidal activity (LC50 18.80 μg/mL); this does not establish effectiveness of live plants. Fermented-ovitrap stations recorded higher descriptive counts than plant-associated stations in a short field comparison, although inconsistent means and non-equivalent sampling mechanisms prevent causal comparisons. Conclusion: Educational and surveillance applications are plausible, but neither reduced larval indices nor dengue incidence has been demonstrated for the combined package. Transparent controlled field evaluation is required.

title: Efeitos do clima nos casos de dengue: uma análise em Rio Verde-GO, 1994-2024 English Climatic effects on dengue cases: an analysis in Rio Verde, Brazil, 1994-2024 Efectos del clima en los casos de dengue: un análisis en Rio Verde, Brasil, 1994-2024
abstract: A dengue constitui importante problema de saúde pública em áreas urbanas tropicais, cuja distribuição se relaciona a fatores climáticos e socioambientais. Este estudo analisou associações entre casos notificados de dengue, variáveis climáticas e características da paisagem urbana de Rio Verde-GO, no Cerrado brasileiro. Foram utilizados dados meteorológicos de 1994 a 2024 (INMET e NASA POWER), registros municipais de dengue de 2016 a 2024 e informações espaciais de uso e cobertura da terra, lotes, renda e densidade demográfica. As análises espaciais por bairro abrangeram 2016–2022 e 2024, enquanto a análise temporal dos padrões construtivos e das características físicas dos lotes nos quatro bairros selecionados compreendeu 2016–2024, incluindo 2023. As séries climáticas e epidemiológicas foram organizadas por semanas epidemiológicas e avaliadas por correlação, considerando defasagens de 4, 8 e 12 semanas. O mapeamento socioambiental empregou QGIS, imagens de satélite, classificação supervisionada por Random Forest, imagens de drone e verificações de campo. Os maiores picos de notificações ocorreram em 2016, 2019, 2022 e 2024, em períodos caracterizados por precipitação frequente e temperaturas mínimas entre 20 °C e 24 °C e máximas entre 30 °C e 35 °C. Nos quatro bairros selecionados, destacaram-se as correlações positivas com construções do tipo caixote (R = 0,8451) e presença de entulho em lotes permeáveis (R = 0,8299). Na análise de uso e cobertura da terra em 191 bairros, destacaram-se as correlações entre notificações e contagens de polígonos classificados como gramíneas (R = 0,6861) e área construída (R = 0,6805). As associações com renda (R = 0,1566), densidade demográfica (R = 0,2120) e idade dos bairros (R = 0,2665) foram de menor magnitude. Conclui-se que os padrões temporais e espaciais das notificações de dengue apresentam associações com a variabilidade climática e a heterogeneidade da paisagem urbana
